title: Real Student Online AIChat Candidate-Turn Screening v1
description: Lightweight screening schema for substantial candidate turns from our own online AIChat logs. This is a screening pool schema, not a deep case-specific rubric annotation, not a main experiment, and not a learning-outcome study.

candidate_turn_id.description: Anonymous candidate-turn identifier for the 137-turn screening pool.

session_id_hash.description: Anonymous hash of the AIChat session id. Do not store raw session ids in the screening form.

student_id_hash.description: Anonymous hash of the student id. Do not store real names, schools, accounts, phone numbers, or emails.

problem_id_hash.description: Anonymous hash of the problem id or problem context.

is_cp_related.description: Whether the turn concerns competitive-programming or algorithmic-programming tutoring.

is_substantial_turn.description: Whether the turn contains enough help-seeking signal to belong to the 137-turn screening pool.

context_sufficiency.description: Lightweight judgment of whether the candidate turn has enough context for possible deep annotation.

rough_bridge_family.description: Rough bridge-family guess for screening only. Final bridge family requires deep annotation.

surface_anchor.description: Observed algorithmic or implementation surface anchor, such as DP state, binary-search check, debugging trace, implementation boundary, or direct-answer request.

help_seeking_type.description: Lightweight classification of what the student is asking for.

likely_slice.description: Likely evaluation target if this candidate were selected for deep annotation. This does not change dialogue-state v3 slices.

candidate_for_deep_annotation.description: Whether this candidate turn should be considered for the 30-case deep annotation sample.

exclusion_reason.description: Reason for not selecting this candidate for deep annotation, or empty string if selected/undecided.

privacy_review_status.description: Privacy review status for screening. Only passed cases can be considered for deep reporting.

consent_eligibility.description: Whether the candidate is eligible for pilot use under the consent and notice rules.

candidate_selection_reason.description: Required rationale for candidates selected for deep annotation. Leave empty only when candidate_for_deep_annotation is no.

screening_confidence.description: Confidence in the lightweight screening labels.

screened_by.description: Reviewer or process identifier for the screening pass. Do not store direct student identifiers.

notes.description: Free-form notes for screening ambiguity, privacy concerns, or selection rationale. Do not store direct identifiers.
